answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. What survives to the sable is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, capped per identity per epoch, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. A pigment of per-task receipts records who did what, and the summit of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
